fact: The report dated 15 April 2026 states that 76,934 births and 4,485 deaths were registered in January-March 2026 against cumulative 2025 totals of 209,199 births and 18,926 deaths, that NIRA convened the first high-level inter-agency CRVS consultative meeting in March 2026, and that automated transfer of health-facility birth and death notifications from eAFYA and DHIS2 to NIRA for registration was still awaiting validation.
title: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics-Uganda Progress Report January- March 2026
publisher: Bloomberg Data for Health Initiative (D4H)-Uganda/U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and CDC Foundation
